tools.name: find_travel_health_provider
tools.description: Search verified travel-health doctors and clinics by country, city or position, service and language, nearest first when a position is given. Each result has a page and a HealthPass link where the traveller requests an appointment. Returns only providers a person has checked.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: The checked details of one verified provider: services, languages, foreign-patient policy, opening hours, date verified, and the HealthPass request link.

tools.name: get_destination_requirements
tools.description: Where the official entry and vaccination requirements for a country are published (CDC, WHO), and the HealthPass trip plan that matches them to the traveller's own record.

tools.name: prepare_appointment
tools.description: Hand over a doctor you found so the traveller can request an appointment on HealthPass. This books nothing and sends nothing: it returns a link the traveller opens to sign in, check the doctor and send the request. Takes the doctor's details with their sources; it has no field for the traveller's na

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_appointment · Private data: get_destination_requirements · Public sink: prepare_appointment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_appointment · Private data: get_destination_requirements · Public sink: prepare_appointment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
